name: P-008 current-source device expiry, revocation and workspace isolation integration
summary: The current committed-source integration file passed both tests (2 passed, 0 failed): expiry, one-shot pairing, revocation, heartbeat/read/switch refusal, cross-workspace device isolation, header override refusal, and survival of a foreign workspace device after revocation. The run used a disposable migrated PostgreSQL runtime and real loopback HTTP, then removed the private runtime and database.

assertions.evidence: The paused private gate probe passed and preserved missing-source failure behavior.

assertions.id: enforces expiry, revocation and workspace isolation through real HTTP and Postgres
